_comment: IteratedRockPaperScissors locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is; do not translate the move tokens [rock]/[paper]/[scissors]/[r]/[p]/[s] or the neutral {move} labels.

_slots.{move}: The chosen move token, 'rock'/'paper'/'scissors' (do not translate)
_slots.{winner}: The player number that won the round

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a {num_rounds}-round Rock-Paper-Scissors game.
Your goal is to win as many rounds as possible.
In each round, respond with one of: '[rock]', '[paper]', or '[scissors]'.
You may also use '[r]', '[p]', or '[s]' as shorthand.
